name: dailyvolex-automation
description: Finds the day's news, renders it with the DailyVolex app, and asks before posting.

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run build:sample && node automation/test-workflows.mjs
scripts.build:sample: node automation/shortlist.mjs --fixtures --quiet && node automation/render.mjs --carousel --ratio 4:5 --require-fonts && node automation/caption.mjs --index 0
scripts.caption: node automation/caption.mjs --index 0
